_: Every ceiling the automation obeys, in one place. scripts/lib/newsroom/limits.mjs is the only reader. Scattering these as constants through the code is how a runaway retry loop becomes a bill, so they live here and the verifier fails the build if a module hard-codes one instead.

perStory._maxAudioRegenerations: A material correction may force a re-narration. Two is enough for a correction and its own correction; a third means something is wrong upstream.

perJob._backoffSeconds: One entry per attempt after the first. The verifier checks the array length matches maxAttempts - 1.

budget._pauseAtPercent: At the pause threshold, expensive generation (model calls, narration) stops. Publishing an already-approved story, serving the site, and sending an already-queued correction are NEVER paused by budget -- a cost ceiling must not become an editorial outage.

intake._minPollIntervalSeconds: Floor applied to every source regardless of its declared pollIntervalSeconds, so a mis-typed registry entry cannot hammer a publisher.
